author: Maya
text: Opening count done before deliveries. Starting the new log today. Mondays still feel like catching up.

author: Maya
text: Lunch was steady. Guests asking if we do breakfast. Theo wants a small weekend menu first.

author: Maya
text: Alder says chicken goes from $3.20/lb to $3.65/lb on Sept 28. Same spec. Wrote it on the order clipboard.

author: Maya
text: We have a Weekend special button in the till now. Kitchen will decide what goes on it. Need to remember to write the recipe down.

author: Maya
text: New prep cook Ivo started today. Portion cards are beside the rice station; please use them.

author: Maya
text: Walk-in felt warm at open. Moved what we could, tossed an unweighed tray of chicken and a tub of cut peppers. Service tech coming. No waste sheet filled out yet.

author: Maya
text: Tech adjusted the door seal. Closing reading looked normal. Keep checking at open.

author: Maya
text: Breakfast tacos launch Saturday Sept 26, weekends 10–2. Two eggs and two tortillas each. Extra egg prep Friday; dinner menu stays on.

author: Maya
text: Alder rep confirmed the route changes Sept 28: Monday/Wednesday instead of Monday/Thursday. Orders by noon the day before. Wednesday has to get us through the weekend.

author: Maya
text: Breakfast was busier than expected. The special was mostly whatever the line could assemble. Nobody wrote down portions.

author: Maya
text: Chicken came in smaller 20 lb cases today. Label is different; kitchen says same cut. Please stop counting cases as if they are all the old size.

author: Maya
text: Alder delivery landed today. Egg shelf is full again. Need to finish reconciling the invoice folder.

author: Maya
text: Breakfast tacos cancelled tomorrow. I think the eggs are on hold after a supplier text. Put a note by the till.

author: Maya
text: Correction to yesterday: called the rep, that hold was for another account. Our eggs are fine. Breakfast tacos ON today; removed the till note.

author: Maya
text: Closing count tonight. Theo expects another busy brunch Oct 10; a neighborhood market opens across the street. No booking numbers yet. Office marked the next chicken order received but I have not seen the cases.
